context: After the date-window fix, re-add benchbox/core/equivalence/builders/flightdata.py (benchmark.generate_data(); tables airlines/airports/flights; FLIGHTDATA_DATAFRAME_QUERIES.get_or_raise), export it, and register flightdata in STAGED_GATES with scale_factor=0.01 -- advisory-first per the campaign's must-preserve, promoted to GATES only once observed stable. The scale MUST stay below 0.1 or a routine PR fetches a real dataset over the network. Triage any residual divergences; do NOT baseline them.
description: FlightData is the only genuinely gateable benchmark left in the coverage map's dual-surface UNGUARDED set: 20 SQL and 20 DataFrame query ids overlap VERBATIM, and its downloader always synthesizes rather than fetching BTS data when SF < 0.1, so a bounded offline cell at SF=0.01 is possible. A builder plus a STAGED_GATES registration was prototyped and RUN in this session: it generated data offline and compared 40 of 40 query-backend cells, so the wiring itself works. It is not landed because the gate is 100% red for reasons outside the gate: the CSV-header loader defect (fixed, PR #1441) and the DataFrame 2018 date window that matches zero rows (this item's dependency). Registering it while red would flip flightdata from UNGUARDED to guarded in the oracle coverage map -- STAGED gates count as a cross-surface oracle -- overstating coverage, which is exactly what that map exists to prevent.
